external_secret.guidance: Condition: isEncrypted=true. Input dictionary polyseed-en,16 words. polyseed.crypt(passphrase or empty) first, then polyseed.generateKey(POLYSEED_MONERO,32) and restoreWalletFromSpendKeySync. Source permits an empty input; the encrypted flag selects this operation regardless of whether a nonempty passphrase was supplied. Not a native seed offset. Source route only; exact native/dependency parity, Unicode normalization and independent wallet recovery unverified. Store required external material only with the original trusted wallet backup; Tessaveil never stores it.
